mechanism: Eslicarbazepine induces CYP3A4 and potentially CYP2C metabolism, which may reduce moxifloxacin levels; moxifloxacin carries inherent QT-prolongation risk, and eslicarbazepine may increase this cardiac risk through additive effects.
action: Monitor QTc interval and moxifloxacin efficacy; consider alternative fluoroquinolone if cardiac risk is high or if therapeutic failure occurs; ensure adequate renal/hepatic function monitoring.
